title.narrative: Informing the Ethiopia cash response through joint market monitoring and supply chain analysis

description.narrative: The action aims to enhance harmonised market price monitoring and supply chain analysis to inform timely and appropriate response actions particularly to food insecurity within Ethiopia. It specifically aims to improve access to timely and accurate regional and nationwide data through the harmonised joint market monitoring framework, and enhance the self-described capacity within Ethiopian government entities to conduct and supply regular and reliable price monitoring data for target regions of Ethiopia
